crossRefs.note: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields…
They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They…
Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!”…
Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you…
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…
You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
